newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Uniwide rated a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Uniwide rated a strong buy.

text.p: Urbancorp Securities Inc recommended on Monday a strong buy on Uniwide Holdings Inc, saying the shares were under-rated and undervalued.

"Its shares are trading at a 1997 P/E multiple of 13.9 times, a huge discount to the 1997 P/E multiple of mall operators ... We believe that Uniwide Holdings deserves to be re-rated upwards as it remains a major player in convenience, retail store operations," analyst Joel Noel Mendoza said.

Mendoza said the company's sale of commercial and residential lots and aggressive expansion of its convenience store outlets could boost its 1997 net income to 971 million pesos from the projected 730 million pesos last year.
"We advise investors to load up on the issue," he added. Uniwide closed unchanged at 5.30 pesos on Monday.
